transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me a little bit about what brings you in to see me today?

I don't know... people just say my talking gets all mixed up. I try to explain things to them... like about the keys, and then the jail... then the prayer rug, or the chess pieces. They just tell me they can't follow what I'm saying. So... that's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling unusually high, energetic, or down and hopeless during the times when your thoughts feel mixed up?

I don't know about high. Just... I wasn't sleeping much. Maybe a few hours a night. I guess I had a lot of energy... I was making all these big plans for the buildings I clean. 

But... yeah, I guess that's when things got mixed up. Because... well, that's when I started hearing that voice coming out of the air vents. And the hallway lights... I was just sure they were sending warnings about me. I... I don't really want to talk about the vents.
Have there been periods in your life where you heard those voices or had those thoughts about the lights even when you were feeling completely normal, without the extra energy or the big plans?

Yeah... I guess so. There were some calmer weeks. I wasn't wired up... wasn't feeling down, either. Just regular. But... for a couple of weeks, maybe more... I still heard him. The man in the vents. And... I still knew people in the building were signaling about me. I just... I don't really want to get into all that.
When you were having those experiences with the voice in the vents during those calmer weeks, how long did that period last?

Like I just said... it was more than two weeks. I wasn't feeling all sped up... wasn't depressed or anything. Just normal. But for that whole time, over two weeks... I still heard him. And I still knew about the people signaling. I just... I really don't want to keep talking about the vents.
